definitions.explanation: Describes food with a light, crisp texture that makes a cracking sound when bitten.
Describes someone who works with energy and drive.

examples.japanese: ぱりぱり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The crispy fried dumplings are delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春巻|はるま}き→春巻き：28818_harumaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぱりぱり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揚|あ}げた→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I deep-fried the spring rolls until crispy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事人|しごとにん}→仕事人：28838_shigotonin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: She is a very ambitious businesswoman.

examples.japanese: ぱりぱり⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧。
examples.english: An energetic young employee who works hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
ぱりぱり is a ⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧/⟦{擬音語|ぎおんご}→擬音語：22536_giongo⟧ (mimetic/onomatopoeic word) describing a thin, crispy texture or the sound of something crispy being eaten or cracked.

COMMON FOOD USES:
- ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧: crispy seaweed
- ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧: crispy dumplings
- ぱりぱり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧: to fry until crispy
- ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: crispy skin (e.g., roast chicken)

OTHER USES:
- ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新札|しんさつ}→新札：27824_shinsatsu⟧: crisp new bills
- ⟦{糊|のり}→糊：03895_nori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぱりぱり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: a shirt stiff with starch

SIMILAR TEXTURE WORDS:
- ⟦さくさく→さくさく：05887_sakusaku⟧: light and crispy (cookies, tempura)
- ⟦かりかり→かりかり：06718_karikari⟧: hard and crunchy (harder than ぱりぱり)
- ⟦ぽりぽり→ぽりぽり：05937_poripori⟧: crunching sound (snacking)
- ⟦ばりばり→ばりばり：05720_baribari⟧: breaking/crunching (harder, louder)
